messages:
alyssa-cs: Customer here — after rotating service account token, batch embeddings calls are getting 403. Single-item embeddings succeed. Repro below.

sam-engr: can you paste the curl and the full 403 body?

alyssa-cs: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":["foo","bar"]}'

Response: 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing required scope: embeddings"}

mira-sso: can you decode the JWT (header.payload.signature) and paste payload? probably a scope claim mismatch

alyssa-cs: decoded payload shows:
```
{"sub":"svcacct:acme-123","scopes":"embeddings\nrerank\ninference","exp":1700000000}
```

kent-support: aha looks like the scp/scopes claim contains newline separators. our auth parser splits on commas only so it treated entire string as single scope "embeddings\nrerank\ninference" and didn't match 'embeddings'.

devops-bot: deploy 6402 started for auth-service (auth-parser-fix)

sam-engr: how did that get created? provisioning script?

alyssa-cs: provisioning team says Okta SCIM app uses `printf "%s\n" "${scopes[@]}"` in the template which left newlines when it wrote the token metadata.

mira-sso: reproducer:
```
# create token playbook
scopes=(embeddings rerank inference)
printf "%s\n" "${scopes[@]}" > claim_scopes
# result: claim value = "embeddings\nrerank\ninference"
```

kent-support: mitigation: re-issue token with scopes joined by space or comma. For affected customers: can we re-provision quickly?

alyssa-cs: customer accepted re-issue. they rotated and new token payload shows: "scopes":"embeddings,rerank,inference" — batch test passes :thumbsup:

sam-engr: longer term: two options:
1) quick patch: auth-service split on any whitespace as well as commas (hotfix) — rolling now (see devops-bot)
2) provider-side: change provisioning templates to join with commas (PR queued)

mira-sso: hotfix is small (14 lines) — plan to roll to prod in next 30m during low traffic window. tagging security for token parsing change.

security-bot: noted. please include tests and backward-compatible parsing.

alyssa-cs: tagging @billing — customer worried tokens caused failed billing metrics because batch requests get 403 vs consumed tokens.

billing: we'll reconcile failed calls; no charge for 403s. we'll follow up with invoice adjustments if needed.

alyssa-cs: closing once hotfix done and customer confirms. thanks everyone :heart:
